description: This file contains unit tests for the VacancyDao class in the Recruitment plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It tests CRUD operations and filtering methods related to vacancy data.

classes.name: VacancyDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing VacancyDao functionalities such as create, read, update, delete, and filter vacancies.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of VacancyDao and populating test data.

methods.name: testSaveVacancy
methods.description: Tests saving a new Vacancy object and verifies fields including name and defined time.

methods.name: testGetVacancyById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a Vacancy by ID and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testUpdateVacancy
methods.description: Tests updating an existing Vacancy and verifies the changes.

methods.name: testDeleteVacancies
methods.description: Tests deleting vacancies by IDs and confirms they are removed.

methods.name: testGetVacancies
methods.description: Tests fetching all vacancies with default filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetVacanciesFilterByJobTitle
methods.description: Tests filtering vacancies by Job Title ID.

methods.name: testGetVacanciesFilterByVacancyId
methods.description: Tests filtering vacancies by specific Vacancy IDs.

methods.name: testGetVacanciesFilterByHiringMangerId
methods.description: Tests filtering vacancies by Hiring Manager Employee Number.

methods.name: testGetVacanciesFilterByStatus
methods.description: Tests filtering vacancies by their status (active/inactive).

methods.name: testGetVacancyListGroupByHiringManager
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of employer numbers grouped by Hiring Manager based on vacancy IDs.

methods.name: testSearchVacanciesCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of vacancies matching given filter parameters.
